text.en:
Barangays Barira, Nabalawag, (Western Part), Tugaig, (Western part), Liong, Lipawan, Bualan,
Gadung, Lipa, Marang, and Ruminimbang, together with the sitios of Midpacor, Palangka, Minabay,
Inipantao, Kendis, Kalimbato, Karosayan, Nituan, Panggao, Sumsed, Cawa, Bangkala, Kaigan, Talaid, Basak,
Racoray, Pedtad, Bukalan, Balut, Rumayas, Pindulunan, Sabpi, Tataya, Pimbago, Tanulang, Pianubkan,
Manuang, Lamin, Kawingis, Palao, Sumiorang, Kagawaran, Tantao, Interior Kalilangan, Bundol, Nagubaran,
Madaya, Calagan, Diromoyod, Kadingilan, Gumatong, Ator, Mate, Tantangan and Ludasan, all in the
municipality of Buldon, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby detached therefrom and crated into a distinct
and separate municipality to be known as the Municipality of Barira with the seat of government in sitio
Pedtad of Barangay Lipawan.

The Municipality of Barira shall have the following boundaries; Beginning at the point at the
peak (Highest point) of Mt. Boroanga along the Maguindanao-Lanao del Sur boundary, following an
imaginary straight line to the South down to the center of the Banganan Falls; thence, from the center of the
said Banganan Falls, following an imaginary downstream line at the center of Banganan River down at the
point in the South where the said Banganan River meets or joins Ambal River, thence following an imaginary
downstream line at the center of the said Ambal River down to the point where said Ambal River meets or
joins Simuay River, thence following the boundary of the municipalities of Buldon and Parang as defined in
Republic Act No. 3419 up to the Maguindanao-Lanao del Sur Boundary, to the point of beginning." (As
defined in Resolution, No. 25, s-1975 of the Municipal Council of Buldon).

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of laws, now of hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the new municipality of Barira.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Buldon shall continue to perform
their duties and such officials in the newly created Municipality of Barira until the municipal officials of said
municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until
their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal officials following the issuance
of this Decree and shall have qualified. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to enable

the government of the Municipality of Barira to operate its organization shall be appointed as provided for
under existing laws.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 29th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
